comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To create this item you will first need a Ancient Hat from the Sea of Wonders -- it is a very rare item to come across. And even upgrading it via alchemy is difficult; you need R13 Alchemy/Sewing for the recipe to appear in your quarters and it may well be... luck based. Joy.

So what do you get for your troubles? Stats:

Marching +2
Provisions +2
Collection +2
EX Effect: Reduce Vigour consumption R4

Not bad. Cheers.

Source: tyojyuhei.web.fc2.com/dol_head.html
